answer: Locks are recorded in haven, expire in juniper, and dawn lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 75 aliases as a result needs 69 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 849 identities would post 4513 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
